title: Licensed Practical Nurse
canonicalBaseline: Career Profiles full snapshot lists Not started; re-read article/source/media rows before any remote write.
intro: Licensed practical nurses (LPNs) provide direct nursing care and help the healthcare team follow a patient’s condition over time. They combine hands-on support with observation, records, and communication. In some states the comparable title is licensed vocational nurse (LVN); national employment statistics often group LPNs and LVNs together.
